title: Error in Rpg Maker XP game export

posts.author: Tisreza
posts.body: So, in 1th sorry for my english, the thing is, i´m making a game with my friends, just for memes, but, in the time to export this, the program export "normally", but, when i open de installator, a error appear's, this says "An error occurred during installation. Try installing again.'' And the only thing that appear's in the folder is the BGM folder, all music's is in it, but always the last music have a error and just occupies +- 474kb. what's happening?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
what is the total size of your project?
I read somewhere that the old compression method of RMXP has an upper limit to how much it can compress.
Iirc there were workarounds to that but I never used XP, so you would have to search the forum for those old topic.

posts.author: Tisreza
posts.body:
Well, the project have a total of 174Mb, but 159Mb of this is just music, so the many musics may be the problem. Very thankyou, i will cut some musics and try to export again
Edit: It REALLY worked, i hadn't realized that the project size was too large for such old software, thankyou so much, i'm very glad to have received your help, God bless you

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
What version of your RPG Maker?
Click on "Ajuda" and then "Sobre...".
From what I see you are using a Portuguese version, as far as I remember there is no official version of this editor in that language.
